title: Service adapters packaged and configured inside Frappe
scope: Make the integration adapters (Jube case lifecycle, Jube tax risk, Docling, OpenAleph/FtM, yente) importable inside the Frappe bench without their heavy dependencies, and provide the site-config factories (e.g. vati_case_lifecycle) with secrets read from ignored local config

acceptance.text: Mount or package integration/ read-only for the bench like ai/ (ADR-023); provide factory functions for every config-injected adapter, starting with vati_case_lifecycle; frappe_dev.py init sets the site config from ignored .local/*.env
On a clean verify site, an officer decision that needs Jube reaches the real local Jube (no jube_not_configured); a missing or unreachable service is reported as unavailable, never silently faked
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: On a clean verify site, an officer decision that needs Jube reaches the real local Jube (no jube_not_configured); a missing or unreachable service is reported as unavailable, never silently faked

notes.text: Added 2026-11-05 after a runtime gap analysis for the RSL demo: the component code existed but this link was not wired at runtime and no task covered it.
